backend_protocol.title: Backend Protocol
backend_protocol.description: The protocol used by the load balancer to forward traffic to backend servers (e.g., HTTP for plaintext, HTTPS for encrypted).

ssl_termination_at_load_balancer.title: SSL/TLS Termination at Load Balancer
ssl_termination_at_load_balancer.description: Indicates whether the load balancer terminates SSL/TLS connections from clients, decrypting traffic before forwarding it to backends.

internal_network_encryption_enforced.title: Internal Network Encryption Enforced
internal_network_encryption_enforced.description: Indicates whether compensating controls (e.g., IPsec, mTLS, VPN tunnels) encrypt traffic on the internal network segment between the load balancer and backend servers.

accepted_tls_versions.title: Accepted TLS Versions
accepted_tls_versions.description: List of TLS protocol versions accepted on the client-facing listener (e.g., TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).

accepted_cipher_suites.title: Accepted Cipher Suites
accepted_cipher_suites.description: List of cipher suites enabled on the client-facing listener, identified by IANA or OpenSSL names.

management_interface_network_exposure.title: Management Interface Network Exposure
management_interface_network_exposure.description: Indicates which network segments the administrative console or API endpoint is accessible from.

ip_allowlist_enforced.title: IP Allowlist Enforced for Management Access
ip_allowlist_enforced.description: Whether access to the management interface is restricted to a defined allowlist of trusted IP addresses or CIDR ranges.

default_credentials_in_use.title: Default Credentials In Use
default_credentials_in_use.description: Whether the management interface still uses vendor-supplied default username/password combinations (e.g., admin/admin, admin/password) that have not been changed after deployment.

password_policy_enforced.title: Strong Password Policy Enforced
password_policy_enforced.description: Whether the management interface enforces a strong password policy (minimum length, complexity, expiration) preventing weak passwords from being set.

admin_account_lockout_enabled.title: Admin Account Lockout Enabled
admin_account_lockout_enabled.description: Whether the management interface locks out accounts after a defined number of consecutive failed login attempts, limiting brute-force attacks on weak credentials.

backend_tls_mode.title: Backend TLS Mode
backend_tls_mode.description: The TLS mode used for connections between the load balancer and backend servers.

backend_client_certificate_configured.title: Backend Client Certificate Configured
backend_client_certificate_configured.description: Whether the load balancer is configured with a client certificate to present to backend servers during TLS handshake.

backend_ca_validation_enforced.title: Backend CA Validation Enforced
backend_ca_validation_enforced.description: Whether the load balancer validates backend server certificates against a trusted CA, preventing impersonation via rogue certificates.

health_check_endpoint_network_exposure.title: Health Check Endpoint Network Exposure
health_check_endpoint_network_exposure.description: Indicates whether the health check endpoint is reachable from untrusted/external networks via the load balancer, or restricted to internal/management networks only.

health_check_response_verbosity.title: Health Check Response Verbosity
health_check_response_verbosity.description: The level of detail returned in health check responses, indicating whether verbose system/application information (versions, dependencies, internal topology, stack traces) is included.

health_check_authentication_required.title: Health Check Authentication Required
health_check_authentication_required.description: Whether the health check endpoint requires authentication (e.g., HTTP basic auth, token, mutual TLS) before returning any response data.

logged_fields.title: Logged Request Fields
logged_fields.description: List of fields the load balancer is configured to include in access logs (e.g., client_ip, request_method, uri, response_code, backend_destination).

access_logging_enabled.title: Access Logging Enabled
access_logging_enabled.description: Whether access logging is enabled at all on the load balancer.

per_source_connection_rate_limit_configu.title: Per-Source Connection Rate Limit Configured
per_source_connection_rate_limit_configu.description: Whether the load balancer enforces a maximum number of new connections per unit time from a single source IP address.

max_concurrent_sessions_per_source_confi.title: Maximum Concurrent Sessions Per Source Configured
max_concurrent_sessions_per_source_confi.description: Whether the load balancer enforces a cap on the number of simultaneous open connections from a single source IP address.

trusted_proxy_header_override_enabled.title: Trusted Proxy Header Override Enabled
trusted_proxy_header_override_enabled.description: Whether the load balancer is configured to strip and rewrite X-Forwarded-For and similar headers before forwarding to backends, ensuring the header reflects the actual client IP rather than any client-supplied value.

client_supplied_forwarded_headers_stripp.title: Client-Supplied Forwarded Headers Stripped
client_supplied_forwarded_headers_stripp.description: Whether the load balancer explicitly removes or sanitizes X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-Host, and Forwarded headers arriving from untrusted external clients before they reach backend servers.

trusted_upstream_cidr_ranges.title: Trusted Upstream CIDR Ranges
trusted_upstream_cidr_ranges.description: List of CIDR ranges from which the load balancer is configured to accept and trust proxy headers. If empty, no IP-based trust restriction is enforced and all sources are implicitly trusted.

process_run_user.title: Load Balancer Process Run User
process_run_user.description: The OS user account under which the load balancer daemon process runs (e.g., root, nobody, haproxy, nginx).

dedicated_service_account_exists.title: Dedicated Service Account Exists
dedicated_service_account_exists.description: Whether a dedicated, low-privilege OS service account has been created specifically for the load balancer daemon.

process_effective_uid.title: Process Effective UID
process_effective_uid.description: The effective numeric user ID of the load balancer daemon process at runtime.

plaintext_secrets_present.title: Plaintext Secrets Present in Configuration
plaintext_secrets_present.description: Whether TLS private keys, API tokens, or administrative passwords are stored in plaintext within load balancer configuration files rather than being referenced via a secrets manager or encrypted vault.

secrets_manager_integrated.title: Secrets Manager Integration Enabled
secrets_manager_integrated.description: Whether the load balancer configuration is integrated with an external secrets management solution (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) so that secrets are fetched at runtime rather than stored in config files.

config_file_permissions_restricted.title: Configuration File Permissions Restricted
config_file_permissions_restricted.description: Whether the load balancer configuration files containing sensitive data are protected with restrictive file permissions (e.g., owner-read-only, mode 0600 or stricter) limiting access to the service account only.

version_has_known_cve.title: Current Version Has Known CVE
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the currently running load balancer software version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs in the NVD or vendor advisory database.

patching_cadence_defined.title: Patching Cadence Defined
patching_cadence_defined.description: Whether a formal, documented patching schedule or automated update mechanism exists for the load balancer software.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Patch Applied
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the load balancer software was last patched or updated to a version addressing known vulnerabilities.

mfa_enforced_on_admin_interface.title: MFA Enforced on Admin Interface
mfa_enforced_on_admin_interface.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for all administrative logins to the load balancer management interface.

admin_auth_method.title: Admin Authentication Method
admin_auth_method.description: The authentication mechanism configured for the load balancer management interface.

management_session_timeout_seconds.title: Management Session Inactivity Timeout (Seconds)
management_session_timeout_seconds.description: The number of seconds of inactivity after which an administrative/management session is automatically terminated. A value of 0 typically means no timeout is configured.

session_timeout_enforced.title: Session Timeout Enforcement Enabled
session_timeout_enforced.description: Indicates whether a session inactivity timeout is actively enforced for management console sessions. True means the timeout mechanism is enabled and applied.

discovery_service_auth_enabled.title: Discovery Service Authentication Enabled
discovery_service_auth_enabled.description: Whether the service discovery integration (e.g., Consul, Kubernetes API, etcd) requires authentication tokens, certificates, or credentials before the load balancer accepts backend node registrations from it.

backend_node_registration_validation_ena.title: Backend Node Registration Validation Enabled
backend_node_registration_validation_ena.description: Whether the load balancer enforces validation (e.g., allowlist, signature check, or approval workflow) on newly discovered or registered backend nodes before adding them to the active pool.

certificate_expiry_alerting_enabled.title: Certificate Expiry Alerting Enabled
certificate_expiry_alerting_enabled.description: Whether automated alerting is configured to notify operators when TLS certificates on client-facing or backend listeners are approaching expiration.

automated_certificate_rotation_enabled.title: Automated Certificate Rotation Enabled
automated_certificate_rotation_enabled.description: Whether an automated mechanism (e.g., ACME/Let's Encrypt integration, secrets manager rotation, CI/CD pipeline) is in place to renew and rotate TLS certificates before expiry on all listeners.

minimum_days_before_expiry_alert.title: Minimum Days Before Expiry Alert Threshold
minimum_days_before_expiry_alert.description: The number of days before certificate expiry at which an alert is configured to fire. A value of 0 means no threshold is set.

icmp_unrestricted.title: ICMP Unrestricted on Load Balancer Interface
icmp_unrestricted.description: Whether ICMP (ping, traceroute, etc.) is permitted on the load balancer's external or management interface without source IP restriction.

snmp_enabled.title: SNMP Enabled on Load Balancer
snmp_enabled.description: Whether SNMP is enabled on the load balancer for monitoring or management purposes.

snmp_source_restricted.title: SNMP Source IP Restricted
snmp_source_restricted.description: Whether SNMP access is restricted to specific trusted source IP ranges (e.g., monitoring servers only), rather than open to all sources.

snmp_community_string_strength.title: SNMP Community String Strength
snmp_community_string_strength.description: Assessment of the SNMP community string in use: whether it is a well-known default, weak/guessable, or a strong custom value.
